admission.justification: The page stream, watcher and serving lifetime share their owner and close paths, preventing a harmless notice stream from breaking the review or leaving subscriptions/tasks alive after disconnect.

applicability: The serving MoveNoticeWatch and review-scoped state stream when explainer application ports are wired. Missing composition leaves no invented watcher or successful explainer route.
conditions: The serving composition supplies explainer watcher ports.
The page or a relevant leaf turn end triggers comparison; a planning leaf is page-open only.
Cooldown reuse is keyed to the current binding/generation/comparison/snapshot.
exclusions: A watcher message, held-store write or host API poll.
An optional notice ending the ordinary review stream or a comparison failure breaking it.
statement: A process-shared moved watcher compares on review-page opening and relevant leaf turn ends and publishes an in-process notice without messaging a seat, writing a held store or making a host call. Planning bindings compare only on page open; repeated page-open reads reuse a short binding-keyed cooldown. Failure logs without breaking the review stream. The ordinary stream controls connection lifetime and disconnect closes its subscriptions; serving shutdown cancels and drains the watcher with other background owners.
